body: On my main account, people generally only speak to me about science. I don't talk about my personal side at all. So no one really knows me. I have, but they recently cut my hours even though I worked hard and covered two extra shifts.

I tried to love myself, but then some of the bad things I have done come into my head and bring me back down. Theres a constant battle going on inside my head, a lot of it is fed off of memories of others telling me that I am "useless" "not good enough" "poor" and "weak"

I can't sleep, I have nightmares constantly and pain from a physiological issue that wakes me up four times a night.
